title: Customer Order Support
meta: We answer order questions by email so your customers feel looked after, using your voice and policies. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Customer order support, answered in your voice
overview: Customers who ask about an order want a quick, kind and accurate answer. We read your policies and past replies, build a set of answers in your voice and then respond to order emails from your support inbox. We look up the order, give the tracking or status and pass anything tricky to you with a short summary. This order covers a set number of replies in the delivery window, and ongoing support is quoted separately.

pkgs.blurb: A reply library and your first order emails answered.
More emails answered with a clear support routine.
A full week of support with reporting and process advice.
list: Tags and a simple help page

faq: Will customers know it is not me?
We write in your voice, using your name or a team name you choose. We do not claim to be anyone we are not, and we sign as your support team.
Which inbox and help tools do you work in?
Gmail, Google Workspace, Outlook, Gorgias, Zendesk, Help Scout and similar. You give us a mailbox or helpdesk seat, and we do not need your main password.
Can you handle angry customers or refunds?
We answer calmly, and refunds or exceptions go to you, as set in your policy. We do not give money back or make promises outside it.
Is this live chat or phone support?
No. This service covers replies by email. We do not take calls or run live chat in this order, but we can set up chat templates if you want them.
